flags.message: In record/documents/questions-presented.txt, the QP extractor cut a body subsection from pages 32-33 of the petition ('E. The Questions Presented In This Case Are Exceptionally Important') instead of page (I) because page (I) of petition.txt has a kerning space in the heading ('QUESTION S PRESENTED'). The verbatim Questions Presented were read directly from page (I) of petition.txt and page (I) of sg-invited-brief.txt.
